set.typical_award_size: FY 2026-27 Action Plan (HHSC April 14, 2026; Council May 5, 2026) assumes CDBG $1,038,891 plus $704,892 prior-year balance and about $150,000 program income, and HOME $383,900 plus $927,785 prior-year balance and about $50,000 program income. CDBG capital awards: Rebuilding Together Silicon Valley repair and accessibility $483,788, Upwards Care Boost microenterprise $552,000; City Home Improvement grants $200,000 and Revolving Loan Fund $240,000 of program income. HOME funds TBRA at about $1 million of rental subsidy a year through Sunnyvale Community Services (two-year contract starting FY 2026-27), with about $792,000 of HOME-ARP planned for year two.
set.affordability_requirement: CDBG low and moderate income benefit; HOME TBRA for low income tenants. The required 15 percent HOME CHDO set-aside is held unallocated because no Sunnyvale CHDO currently qualifies; it may be reprogrammed if not committed within two years.
set.cycle_notes: CDBG capital project proposals are considered annually (RFP each January); CDBG public services and HOME TBRA are competed every two years with two-year awards (the January 2026 RFP covered FY 2026-27 CDBG capital and FY 2026-27 and 2027-28 HOME TBRA). Action Plan adopted each spring.
set.next_deadline: No open round as of November 9, 2026. Next CDBG capital RFP expected January 2027 for FY 2027-28; next HOME TBRA and public services RFP expected January 2028.
set.prevailing_wage_basis: CDBG: Davis-Bacon applies to residential construction or rehabilitation of 8 or more units (42 U.S.C. 5310; 24 CFR 570.603). HOME: 24 CFR 92.354 applies at 12 or more HOME-assisted units. Current uses (owner-occupied single-family repair, TBRA, microenterprise) fall below these thresholds.
